integrity.external_validation: No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
integrity.proof_basis: Explicit transition proof and a case analysis of all one- and two-state visible transition maps.
integrity.reproducibility: The standalone verify.py uses only the Python standard library and checks the witness plus all 128 labeled two-state binary DFAs.

scientific_limitations: The exact minimum is proved for a minimal complete commutative input DFA with one visible letter and a nonempty hidden alphabet, when the infinite projected language has the same minimal state count.
No general formula for projected-language state complexity or classification for multiple visible letters is claimed.
The literature comparison is limited to the inspected primary sources and indexed searches; an unindexed equivalent witness may exist.
title: A minimal non-partition projection witness in commutative automata
